data.name: Subsuelo
data.detailed_description:
Synopsis

Subsuelo is a survival horror game where you step into the shoes of a young aspiring Argentine journalist, determined to make a name for himself in the profession. The opportunity arrives unexpectedly: an acquaintance calls you urgently to tell you that, during some construction work, they have discovered a mysterious facility from the 70s of which there is no record.

What happened there? Why has it remained hidden for so long?

Driven by ambition and curiosity, you don't hesitate for a second. As a player, you risk everything, even your own life, to enter that forgotten place and unravel its secrets, in what could become the opportunity of a lifetime.

Features:

  • Use firearms and melee weapons to defend yourself.

  • Jumpscares and events that will give you goosebumps.

  • Intelligent enemies that will stalk you at all times.

  • Puzzles and mini-games that you must solve to progress.

  • Inventory management—don't let go of anything that might be useful later.

Subsuelo is an Argentine video game developed by a single person that invites you to discover an alternative history of the events that occurred between 1976 and 1983 in a fictional facility where the government sought to create the ultimate weapon to win the war.

data.short_description: Subsuelo is a horror game where you uncover an alternate version of events that took place in Argentina between 1976 and 1983. Explore a fictional facility abandoned by the government, where secret experiments were conducted in an attempt to create the ultimate weapon to win the war.
